purpose: Provider public-terms triage for HOST-001..003. This artifact records official public-source restrictions, permissions and missing evidence only. It is not a provider contract, order form, redistribution license, account entitlement, legal approval, or executable provider-rights bundle and must never promote hosted provider eligibility.
runtimePromotionRule: Only separately reviewed provider-specific legal/data-rights evidence applicable to DE.PULSE may be transformed into the SHA-256-pinned provider-rights-bundle-v19.0.0 executable contract. For private/commercial providers this may require an executed agreement/license/order form. For public-government providers, official reuse/API terms may be sufficient only after a documented legal review maps every required hosted-use dimension and operational obligation. Public web terms or working credentials alone never auto-promote rights.
